title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF&39;s WASH Program in Burkina Faso advanced the National WASH in School strategy by equipping 300 schools with essential facilities, benefiting 100,000 students. It prioritized inclusivity with solar water systems and gender-specific latrines. Despite challenges, strategic collaboration propelled significant progress and set the foundation for increased achievements.
